details.biography:
Jacob's Well (first Keepers) · Seat 5, Spare: front line

A broad, grey-green half-orc with a shaved head and a wolf's-tooth necklace, raised by human trappers after a raid took his mother's people. Quiet until he isn't. He signed with the Keepers because they pay on time and nobody asks where he was born, and he likes Brenna more than she likes him.

Tonight: The orc chieftain in the common room knows your clan's markings, and he hasn't stopped staring.

In a fight

Rage on your first swing. Power Attack big targets with your first attack each round (Reckless gives nothing to a Power Attack, so pick Brutal and knock foes down for the others instead). Whirlwind when two weaklings crowd you, and throw a hand axe at anything that runs.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities

Rage. As part of an attack or your move, rage for the rest of the encounter, 4 times a day. While raging, +2 melee weapon damage (two-handed axe 1d12+4). It ends early if a full round passes without you attacking or taking damage.

Rage Styles (2nd). Each time you rage, pick one for that rage. Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round, but attacks against you have Advantage. Brutal: once a round when you hit, shove the target 10ft or knock it Prone (Fortitude save, DC 14). Terrifying: once per rage, Intimidate as part of an attack instead of with your action.

Whirlwind Attack (3rd). Once per rage, while raging, in place of your action: one attack roll against each of up to 2 foes within 5ft whose Level is 1 or lower. Not after retreating.

Intimidate (Strength). Uses your action. One creature of your Level or lower within 15ft makes a Will save (DC 14) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn. No daily limit.

Combat Sense. Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised. Attackers gain no Advantage on you from flanking or from being unseen, and Back Attack and the like don't work on you.

Primeval Instincts. Works in your scale mail (War Barbarian). Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks in extreme circumstances; you hold your breath twice as long and survive extreme cold and weather a day longer; Advantage on Fortitude saves to force march; you find shelter, food and water for yourself in the wild, light a fire in 1d10 minutes, always know north, and climb natural slopes and swim rivers at half speed without a check.

Thick Hide. +2 AC with no armour or light armour, so not in your scale mail.

Kit: War Barbarian. Armoured Fury: trained in heavy armour, and Primeval Instincts works in medium armour. Iron Rage: while you rage in medium or heavy armour, the first attack against you each round has Disadvantage.

Power Attack (feat, 1st). With the two-handed axe, your first attack each round can be a Power Attack: Disadvantage that no Advantage cancels, but a hit deals one extra d12. Never on an attack that already has Disadvantage.

Cleave (feat, 2nd). Cleave up to three times a turn with your two-handed axe (Cleaving), twice with anything else.

Half-Orc. Darkvision 60ft. Relentless Endurance: once a day, when damage would drop you to 0 HP or below, drop to 1 instead. Brutal Strikes: on a critical hit, roll one extra weapon die. Onslaught: spend 1 Luck to make one more weapon attack, in the same action, against a creature you've just damaged. Advantage on Tracking checks (chosen skill).

Armour Class on the sheet: Scale mail +4, Dex +1

Class Abilities

1st Level

Combat Sense

  • Effect: Heightened battlefield awareness that makes the Barbarian difficult to catch off guard.
  • Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised
  • Attackers gain no Advantage from flanking or from being Unseen against you
  • Back Attack and similar rear-attack bonuses (such as the Rogue's) do not work against you

Rage

  • Effect: As part of an attack or your movement, enter a rage that lasts for the encounter, usable 1 + Constitution modifier times per day (minimum 2/day).
  • While raging, gain a flat bonus to melee weapon damage: +2 (1st-9th level), +4 (10th-19th level), +6 (20th+).
  • Rage ends early if a full round passes without the Barbarian attacking or taking damage.
  • Stacks normally with Primeval Will and Whirlwind Attack.

Intimidate (Strength)

  • Effect: Uses your action. One creature of equal or lower Level within 15ft makes a Will save (against your Class Save DC) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
  • No daily limit

Primeval Instincts

  • Effect: When not wearing medium or heavy armour and having not fled the challenge, have Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks in extreme circumstances.
  • Hold your breath twice as long as normal
  • Survive extreme temperatures and weather 1 day longer than normal
  • Advantage on Fortitude saves made to force march
  • Find shelter, food, and water for themselves automatically in any wilderness environment (1d6+2 hours)
  • Start a fire in 1d10 minutes by natural means
  • Determine true north at will
  • Climb typical natural slopes and swim typical rivers without a check — half speed, in light armour or none
  • Cannot use the shelter, fire, navigation and climbing abilities above while wearing medium or heavy armour

Thick Hide

  • Effect: While wearing no armour or light armour, gain +2 AC (+3 from 10th level). It does not stack with other bonuses of the same kind.

2nd Level

Rage Styles

  • Effect: Each time you enter a rage, choose one style. It lasts for that rage.
  • Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round, but attacks against you have Advantage. 8th level: only the first attack against you each round has Advantage
  • Brutal: once per round, when you hit, shove the target 10ft or knock it Prone (Fortitude save against your Class Save DC). 8th level: on a failed save, you shove the target 10ft and knock it Prone
  • Terrifying: once per rage, use Intimidate as part of an attack instead of your action. 8th level: once per rage, as part of an attack, Intimidate every creature of your choice within 15ft (each saves separately; Intimidate's Level limit applies)
  • 8th level: your styles improve, as listed under each one.

3rd Level

Whirlwind Attack

  • Effect: Once per rage, while raging, replace your action: make one attack roll against each of up to 2 opponents within 5ft whose Level is no greater than half the Barbarian's level.
  • Can split attacks between targets freely
  • Cannot retreat before using it
  • Scales with level — see the Barbarian Progression Table
  • 13th level: the targets' Level may be up to your Level

4th Level

Primeval Will

  • Effect: Once per day, when HP is reduced to twice your level or less, immediately gain bonus HP equal to twice your level.
  • The bonus HP absorb incoming damage first
  • Any remaining bonus HP are removed at combat's end
  • If reduced to 0 or negative HP before activation, it triggers automatically — if the resulting total is 1 or more HP, the Barbarian keeps fighting
  • Cannot prevent death from a blow that would kill you outright

5th Level

Ancestral Calling

  • Effect: The first time you rage each day, allies within 30ft gain temporary HP equal to your Barbarian level, lasting until the end of the day. Always on.
  • Cannot combine with another Barbarian's Ancestral Calling

6th Level

Force of Nature

  • Effect: Gain a +1 bonus to saving throws against spells and magical effects. Magic from the primeval world bends around the Barbarian's raw will.
  • Improves to +2 at 16th level
  • Improves to +3 at 19th level
  • Improves to +4 at 22nd level

7th Level

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

9th Level

Iron Sinews

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks count as magic, so they can harm creatures that only magic weapons can hurt.

15th Level

  • Strength Bonus: permanent +1 Strength

20th Level

Warlord

  • Effect: Once per month, in an area where the Barbarian's name and deeds are known, call up an army of 10–100 1st level barbarians.
  • Requires a population of 500 per 10 men needed in the area
  • Army stats: AC 13, armed with sword or axe
  • For every 20 barbarians, a 3rd level barbarian leads them
  • They fight for 30 days without pay — food and water only
  • Repeated failed campaigns reduce this ability until reputation is restored

24th Level

World Ender

  • Effect: Your mastery of combat reaches a mythic threshold — nothing within reach is safe, and nothing without magic stops you.
  • Whirlwind Attack can now target all creatures within 10ft regardless of Level; the normal Level cap is removed entirely

Kits: Arneyan Warrior Cultures

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Barbarian folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Your kit defines the warrior culture that shaped you.

While you rage in medium or heavy armour, the first attack against you each round has Disadvantage.

(Smash)

Put everything into the swing with a melee weapon that has the Heavy trait, held in two hands.

  • Trade your usual precision for a strike that lands like a falling tree — roll the attack with Disadvantage (any Advantage you would have on it is ignored, so it can never cancel the Disadvantage), but if it connects, roll one extra weapon damage die and add it to the damage (two extra dice from 10th level).
  • It can only be your first attack each round, and never an attack that already has Disadvantage.
  • It cannot be combined on the same attack with another option that gives your own attack Disadvantage (Shield Blow).

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.
